We offer authentic and traditional Ayurvedic treatments for Disc prolapse where we use specially prepared ayurvedic medicines which are manufactured in our own manufacturing unit. The patient will get relief from the pain after the first day of our treatment itself. Normally we admit the patients for 21 days.   During the first week itself, you will get considerable relief and within 2 to 3 weeks (more than 90% cases) your pain, swelling, bulging, stiffness etc…will subside and you will get back mobility and flexibility. Rare cases, it may take some more time. Patient has to continue the medicines normally for 6 months to 1 year.

This is pure Ayurvedic treatment and free from side effects.  Our medicines and treatments help to remove the side effects of medicines that you have taken earlier.  This is one of the major benefits of taking treatment from us. You can go to our testimonials page, where you can see the patients who have written or told their experience with name and address, (photo if available). Some of them may be of you or you may have some close friend known to them. You can enquire them personally.

Our Disk prolapse treatment is divided in to two parts, detoxification therapy and medicine. Detoxification is having much importance in our treatment which helps to remove the toxins, swelling, stiffness and bulging. We use different Panchakarma techniques like massage, Elakizhi, NjavaraKizhi/Payasam, Vasthi, Pichu, Nasyam, Medicated Steam bath etc… as per the severity and condition of the patient. We are using special internal and external Ayurvedic medicines for this purpose.   A complete investigation before and after the treatment will help you to evaluate the treatment, and gives you more satisfaction.

 Note:

Kindly bring or send your test reports [blood tests {C-reactive protein (CRP),erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) etc…},x-rays, C.T, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan.] to our mail ID for evaluating the prognosis of the disease (test reports if available).

We are using pure Ayurvedic medicines for the treatment of Disk prolapse. We have our own special medicines for internal and external use which are manufactured in our Medicine Manufacturing unit, having GMP Certificate.

Rare cases the duration may increase. If the patient is having more than one ailment, the duration of the treatment may increase.

  1. Normally, patients will get some relief and pain will reduce and can leave the painkiller after the first day of our treatment itself.   Usually, within 2 or 3 days they will feel much better and relaxed.

  4. In our treatment there is no risky operation, or painful therapy etc…  It is 100% safe and protects your health.

  6. Our treatment increase the blood supply in the affected parts and the cells will get more oxygen and nutrients and this helps to rebuild the degenerated parts, and stops further degeneration.
  7. Our treatment is free from side effects.
  8. Our treatments and medicines help to remove the side effects of medicines that you have taken earlier.

 

What is I.V.D.P (DISC PROLAPSE)?

Spinal disc prolapse (herniation) is a condition affecting the spine in which there is a Tear in the outer fibrous ring of an intervertebral disc which allows the soft central portion to bulge.Symptoms vary depending on the location of the herniation and the types of soft tissue that become involved.

Signs and symptoms include:

  1. little or no pain if the disc is the only tissue injured
  2. Pain that will radiate into the regions served by affected nerve roots that are irritated or impinged by the herniated material.
  3. Undefined pains in the thighs, knees or feet.
  4. Numbness, tingling, muscular weakness, paralysis, and affection of reflexes
  5. If the herniated disc is in the lumbar region, the patient may also experience pain which is usually continuous or at least is continuous in a specific position of the body.

Causes:

  1. Disc prolapse can result from general wear and tear, such as when performing jobs that require constant sitting, lifting etc….
  2. Traumatic injury to lumbar discs that commonly occurs when lifting and bending at the waist.
